faq.q: Does living near White Rock Christian Academy get a child a place?
faq.a: No. White Rock Christian Academy is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the White Rock Christian Academy home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names White Rock Christian Academy. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 2 km away.

items.t: Ask White Rock Christian Academy how admission works. A short distance does not give a child a place.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near White Rock Christian Academy are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Walk the route to White Rock Christian Academy the way a child would, and count the crossings and sidewalks.
